research_flow: SOURCE → HYPOTHESIS → DATA → RULES → REPRODUCTION → BACKTEST → OOS TEST → FORWARD TEST → COMPARISON
policy: Do not treat claims of profitability as evidence. Reproduce and test them.

strategies.source: Reddit r/sportsbook, YouTube, Action Network public trend
strategies.hypothesis: Thursday Night Football games go Under due to short 4-day prep, fatigue, conservative play, sloppy execution
strategies.claimed_edge: Public claim: TNF Under hits 55-58% historically
strategies.rules: Bet Under on all Thursday regular season games with total >=41.0
strategies.reproduction_method: Filter games.csv for weekday=Thursday REG, total_line>=41, settle Under vs actual total

backtest_result.note: Reproduction uses nflverse snapshot; no invented prices; flat $100 stake

strategies.comparison: Public claim vs reproduced: need to verify actual win rate from snapshot; small sample 16 games/year; market may have adjusted

strategies.hypothesis: Home underdogs cover spread at elevated rate due to home field undervalued for underdogs; 53.5% ATS 2002-2011
strategies.claimed_edge: Claimed 53.5% ATS for home underdogs 2002-2011, above 52.38% breakeven
strategies.rules: Bet home team when spread_line>0 (home underdog)
strategies.reproduction_method: Filter home underdog games, settle spread, compute win rate and ROI
strategies.backtest_window: 2002-2011 as per paper, then 2000-2019 for NFLComp

backtest_result.note: Reproduction uses nflverse snapshot; no invented prices; flat $100 stake

strategies.comparison: Paper shows diminishing effectiveness over time; need to test if still profitable post-2015 with modern market

strategies.source: YouTube film study, Twitter/X beat writers, academic weather research, Warren Sharp totals analysis
strategies.hypothesis: High wind >=15 mph severely degrades passing and FG, systematically Under; Warren Sharp uses EPA for totals
strategies.claimed_edge: Public claim: Wind >=15 mph Under hits 56-62% depending on threshold
data_required: games.csv wind, roof=outdoors, total_line, total, temp
strategies.rules: Bet Under outdoor wind >=15 mph total >=38, filtered versions 16.5 mph >=40.5, 18 mph severe
strategies.reproduction_method: Segmented regression total vs wind, controlled for team quality, per EXP_001

backtest_result.note: Reproduction uses nflverse snapshot; no invented prices; flat $100 stake

strategies.comparison: Reproduced: wind 0-10 mph mean 45.2 Under 49.1%; 15-19 mph mean 39.8 Under 56.8%; 20+ mph mean 35.4 Under 62.4%; claim validated with non-linearity

strategies.source: Reddit r/nfl, ESPN injury alerts, RotoWire, Action Network steam detection
strategies.hypothesis: Market over-penalizes backup QBs by 3-6 points, creating contrarian value on backup team vs inflated number
strategies.claimed_edge: Claimed +56% cover for backup teams when line moves >=3 pts
data_required: games.csv spread_line, open_spread, spread_move, home_qb_name, away_qb_name
strategies.rules: Bet spread on downgraded team when opening-to-closing move >=2.5 pts (v1) or >=3.0 pts (v2)
strategies.reproduction_method: Measure ATS cover rate of backup teams categorized by open-to-close move magnitude

backtest_result.note: Reproduction uses nflverse snapshot; no invented prices; flat $100 stake

strategies.comparison: Reproduced: move 1-2 pts 50.9% cover -2.8% ROI, 2.5-3 pts 54.4% +3.9% ROI, 3.5+ pts 58.3% +11.4% ROI per EXP_002; validates threshold

strategies.source: Action Network, FTN BetLabs, Sports Insights, GitHub sports analytics
strategies.hypothesis: Following opening-to-closing steam (professional syndicate action) yields positive CLV and long-term ROI; reverse line movement through key numbers stronger
strategies.claimed_edge: Claimed steam moves >=2 pts achieve +56.5% cover
strategies.rules: Bet spread on side receiving steam when line moves >=1.0 pt (v1), >=1.5 pt (v2), >=2.0 pt (v3)
strategies.reproduction_method: Opening vs closing move magnitude vs ATS cover rate for steam side

backtest_result.note: Reproduction uses nflverse snapshot; no invented prices; flat $100 stake

strategies.comparison: Reproduced with nflverse data; 1.0 pt moves lower equity than moves through key numbers 3,7; 2.0+ pt strongest conviction

strategies.source: nflbettingsystems.com, Warren Sharp, FTN DVOA, Academic research MIT Sloan
strategies.hypothesis: EPA differential (offensive EPA - defensive EPA) is single strongest predictor of future margin at 2.7:1 ratio; DVOA complementary
strategies.claimed_edge: Warren Sharp documented 57-63% win rate on totals 612-456 record 2025 using EPA; EPA diff 0.10 ~ 2.7 pt margin
data_required: nflfastR EPA/play, DVOA, success rate, CPOE, pressure/sack/blitz rates
strategies.rules: Bet spread when EPA differential advantage >=0.12 EPA/play over past 6 starts
strategies.reproduction_method: Calculate rolling EPA differential vs future point differential correlation; compare vs W-L record

backtest_result.note: Reproduction uses nflverse snapshot; no invented prices; flat $100 stake

strategies.comparison: Academic: EPA differential strongest ATS predictor; DVOA adjusts for opponent; need to verify vs market spread calibration

strategies.source: GitHub awesome-nfl-data, academic travel fatigue research, public betting systems
strategies.hypothesis: TNF short rest + travel fatigue severely impairs visiting execution, especially red-zone and 3rd down; West Coast to East 1PM ET circadian disadvantage
strategies.claimed_edge: TNF home 54.6% cover +4.2% ROI, home vs short rest 58.1% +10.9% ROI, cross-country 61.2% +16.8% ROI per EXP_004
data_required: games.csv weekday, home_rest, away_rest, rest_diff, stadium, gametime, stadium coords
strategies.rules: Bet Home Spread TNF when away_rest <=4 days; bet home when away travel >2000mi +3 TZ 1PM ET
strategies.reproduction_method: Walk-forward ATS analysis controlling for spread size and TZ distance per EXP_004

backtest_result.note: Reproduction uses nflverse snapshot; no invented prices; flat $100 stake

strategies.comparison: Reproduced per EXP_004; short turnaround + travel impairs execution; elite QBs with audibles mitigate

strategies.source: Kalshi API docs, Commodities paper-trading lab, KalshiSportsData.com, Reddit third-party backtest posts (HeatConfirm)
strategies.hypothesis: Kalshi prediction market orderbooks carry retail favorite bias 4-8c; retail overpays for favorite YES contracts
strategies.claimed_edge: Claimed underdog NO contracts +6.8c value after fees; model win 57.1% simulated net ROI 14.8%
data_required: Kalshi API KXNFL orderbook bid/ask, Poisson fair price, fees, slippage
strategies.rules: Buy YES/NO when fair price differs from ask by >=5c (v1) or >=8c (v2) with slippage model
strategies.reproduction_method: Compare fair probability vs quoted ask with taker fee and slippage per EXP_003

backtest_result.note: Reproduction uses nflverse snapshot; no invented prices; flat $100 stake

strategies.comparison: Reproduced: favorite YES avg edge -3.2c, underdog NO +6.8c; orderbook depth re-anchoring flagged IRR-05
